messages:
Priya: Tiny but huge update2a we just closed $50M ARR this quarter!! :tada: cant stop grinning.
Omar: WHAT. Holy guacamole. Celebration plan: sock-puppet parade + cake? :cake:
Jin: Sock puppets? 10/10 chaotic and delightful. Also can we do a merch vote for a limited-run tee or enamel pin?
Remy: Poll: React :one: for tee, :two: for pin, :three: for both (if you're rich or supportive). Also remote folks get a virtual puppet kit.
ops-bot: Heads-up: deploy window at 20:00 UTC. No impact on celebrations but FYI. :white_check_mark:
Priya: @Remy love both but let's let the team decide. Voting until 12:00. We'll ship to global addresses next week.
Omar: I can mock a tee design tonight. Thinking: little server with a cape and "50M" badge. Link to sketch: https://stash.example/50m-design (placeholder)
Jin: I volunteer to handcraft sock puppets. Yes I have hot glue and unreasonable enthusiasm.
Jordan: Huge congrats everyone  phenomenal work. Quick 10-min town-hall at 3pm for a tiny retrospective + thank-yous? I can drop in.
Remy: Town-hall + puppet parade at 3:15 in the atrium. Remote folks: drop a 30s celebration clip or join via the call.
Priya: Also shoutout to infra & support for the late-night firefights last month. @ops-bot log shows saved sessions at 02:12. Legends.
Omar: Can we do a tiny assistant award? Best war-story gets a plush puppet. Nominate below with a one-liner.
Jin: Nominate @Lea for "grace under load"  single-line fix that prevented rollback.
Remy: Noted. Adding sticker packs and a small Spend-a-Coffee card for remote folks.
Priya: Thanks team. See you at 3pm with your puppets, voices, and gratitude. Also cake will be labeled with dietary tags. <3
